name: Tecnam P2010
summary: Modern four-seat high-wing from Italy with a carbon-fibre fuselage, metal wings and an all-moving stabilator; offered with a Lycoming or a diesel engine and a three-door cabin.

wings: High wing braced by one strut per side
Semi-tapered wing with flaps on the inboard section
engines: Single flat-four in a smoothly shaped cowl
fuselage: Sleek carbon-fibre fuselage with large, wraparound windows
Three doors: two front and one on the right rear
Fixed tricycle gear with all three wheels in streamlined fairings

tellTales: Strut-braced high wing on a sleek, modern fuselage with streamlined wheel fairings
All-moving tail on a swept fin

confusedWith.howToTell: The P2010 has a sleeker fuselage, faired wheels and a stabilator; the 172 has unfaired struts, a conventional tail and the older squared cabin.
The P2010 is smaller with a lighter-looking nose; the 182 has a deeper, blunter cowl.
The P2010 is a high-wing; the Cessna 400 is a low-wing.
